description: URL encode a string value and return the string result: every character is percent-encoded as UTF-8 except A-Z a-z 0-9 ; , / ? : @ & = + $ - _ . ! ~ * ' ( ) #. Characters that give a URI its structure are kept, so this encodes a whole URI, not a single query value or path segment.

parameters.description: The string value to URL encode.
parameters.name: unencoded
